query:
INSERT INTO doc_sequence_counters (id, document_type, company, year, current_value, updated_at)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(ds.document_type, '-CJB-', ds.year) as id,
  ds.document_type,
  'CJB' as company,
  ds.year,
  MAX(ds.sequence_number) as max_seq,
  NOW() as updated_at
FROM doc_sequences ds
WHERE ds.created_by = 'historical_import'
GROUP BY ds.document_type, ds.year
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
  current_value = GREATEST(doc_sequence_counters.current_value, VALUES(current_value)),
  updated_at = NOW();
